# Confirm: `jl-confirm`

A yes-or-no question in a small modal, and confirmDialog() to ask it with await.

- Class `JlConfirm`, a organism: `import { JlConfirm } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/confirm

A yes-or-no question before something that matters: deleting, publishing, leaving with unsaved
changes. confirmDialog() asks it in one line of code and resolves the answer: true when confirmed, false when
cancelled with the button, Escape or a click outside. It makes a jl-confirm, adds it to the page, and removes it
once answered.

The danger tone draws the confirm button in red and starts the focus on Cancel, so a quick Enter never destroys
anything; the accent tone starts on the confirm button. Write the jl-confirm element yourself to ask the same
question several times, with ask().

## Use

```ts
import { JlConfirm } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlConfirm
  confirmLabel="Discard"
  heading="Discard your changes?"
  text="The edits since your last save are lost."
  tone="danger"
/>
```

```html
<jl-confirm
  confirm-label="Discard"
  heading="Discard your changes?"
  text="The edits since your last save are lost."
  tone="danger"
></jl-confirm>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. The question.
- `text` (attribute `text`): `string`, default `''`. What follows from the answer.
- `confirmLabel` (attribute `confirm-label`): `string`, default `''`. The confirm button: say what it does, "Delete", rather than "OK". Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `cancelLabel` (attribute `cancel-label`): `string`, default `''`. The cancel button. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `tone` (attribute `tone`): `'accent' | 'danger'`, default `'accent'`. The colour of the confirm button; danger also starts the focus on Cancel.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `confirm` (`onConfirm` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The question was confirmed.
- `cancel` (`onCancel` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The question was cancelled: its button, Escape or the backdrop.

## Slots

- The default slot: More content under the text.

## Methods

- `ask(): Promise<boolean>`: Opens the question; resolves true when confirmed, false otherwise.
- `confirmDialog(options: ConfirmOptions): Promise<boolean>`: A function, not a method: asks in a new jl-confirm and removes it once answered. Options: heading, text, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, tone.
- `guardLeave(options: LeaveGuardOptions): () => Promise<boolean>`: A function: guards a form against leaving with changes not saved. Closing the tab asks the browser's question; the function it returns asks "Leave without saving?" in the page (the texts leaveHeading, leaveText, leave and stay), for the router to call before it moves on: a Jadis page sets it as its canLeave, which the router waits for from @jadis/core 1.5.1. Options: isDirty, signal, heading, text, leaveLabel, stayLabel.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Asking with confirmDialog()

confirmDialog() resolves the answer; the dialog goes away once answered.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="delete" variant="danger" icon="trash" label="Delete project"></jl-button>
  <span class="muted answer">No answer yet.</span>
</div>
```

```js
import { confirmDialog } from '@syware/jlib';

const answer = root.querySelector('.answer');
root.querySelector('.delete').events.register('press', async () => {
  const confirmed = await confirmDialog({
    heading: 'Delete “Q3 roadmap”?',
    text: 'The project and its 24 files are deleted for everyone. This cannot be undone.',
    confirmLabel: 'Delete project',
    cancelLabel: 'Keep it',
    tone: 'danger',
  });
  answer.textContent = `The answer: ${confirmed}`;
});
```

### Accent

The accent tone, for a decision that destroys nothing.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="publish" variant="primary" icon="rocket" label="Publish"></jl-button>
  <span class="muted answer">No answer yet.</span>
</div>
```

```js
const confirmed = await confirmDialog({
  heading: 'Publish the release notes?',
  text: 'Everyone following the project gets an email.',
  confirmLabel: 'Publish',
});
```

### As an element

The element in the page, asked again at each press; rich content goes in its slot.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button class="leave" icon="log-out" label="Leave the workspace"></jl-button>
  <span class="muted answer">No answer yet.</span>
</div>
<jl-confirm class="leave-question" heading="Leave Acme?" confirm-label="Leave" tone="danger">
  <p class="muted">You lose access to its 12 projects. An admin can invite you back.</p>
</jl-confirm>
```

```js
const question = root.querySelector('jl-confirm');
root.querySelector('.leave').events.register('press', async () => {
  answer.textContent = `The answer: ${await question.ask()}`;
});
```
